clips.title: The story
paras: Commissioned by Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill, this quest tasks Horde agents with testing a newly brewed biological concoction known as the Elixir of Pain. The Forsaken apothecary selects Stanley, a pet dog belonging to Farmer Ray in the Hillsbrad Fields, as an unsuspecting test subject.

Operating out of Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon conducts experiments on behalf of the Royal Apothecary Society and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. Utilizing fresh blood gathered from the local wildlife, Lydon concocts a volatile mixture he dubs the Elixir of Pain. Rather than relying purely on theoretical alchemy, the society requires empirical field data to observe the physiological effects of their experimental poisons and mutagens.

To evaluate the draught without alarming the human defenders of Hillsbrad, Lydon directs his agents to target the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields. There lives Stanley, a seemingly harmless pet dog kept by Farmer Ray. Approaching the unsuspecting canine with the draft poured into an open hand, the agent administers the dose under the guise of an ordinary treat.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, nothing like the smell of fresh blood in the foothills!

Now we'll mix in a touch of this and a little of that and let the real fun begin! What I have created with this blood, I like to call an Elixir of Pain. If my calculations are correct this concoction could be the start of something very beautiful for Lady Sylvanas. But what we need is a test.
Take this elixir out to the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields to the southwest. Let's see how Farmer Ray's little dog Stanley likes this "treat."

clips.title: Completion
paras: You pour some of the elixir into your hand and hold it before Stanley's mouth.
